gaps.sentence: ___ had we sat down than the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner' pairs with 'than'; hardly/scarcely pair with 'when'.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we arrived ___ the storm broke.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly... when' is the fixed pair for one event interrupting another.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.

gaps.sentence: She kept every receipt ___ she could claim the expenses back.
gaps.explanation: 'So that + could' expresses purpose; 'in case' expresses precaution.

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.

gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: I'll tell you everything ___ you promise to keep it between us.
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' sets the condition attached to the promise.
